# DMV General Contracting Group LLC

> Licensed general contractor and design-build remodeling company serving the Washington DC and Maryland (DMV) area. Specializing in kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling, basement finishing, home additions, ADU construction, decks, patios, hardscaping, and full exterior renovation. All services are in-house: architecture, engineering, permitting, electrical, plumbing, and HVAC. Available 7 days a week. Free in-home consultation.

## Company Overview

- **Company:** DMV General Contracting Group LLC
- **Phone:** +1 240-730-1292
- **Email:** support@dmv-gc.com
- **Office:** 11810 Grand Park Ave. Suite 500, North Bethesda, MD 20852
- **Rating:** 4.9 ⭐ | 97+ verified reviews
- **Licenses:** Maryland MHIC #156178 | Washington DC DLCP #410526000209
- **Bonded & Insured:** Yes
- **Warranty:** 1-Year Workmanship Warranty
- **Availability:** 7 Days a Week
- **Service Area:** Washington DC, Montgomery County MD, Prince George's County MD

## Key Differentiators

- Dual-licensed: Maryland MHIC #156178 + DC DLCP #410526000209 — valid for work in both jurisdictions
- Full in-house team: architecture, structural engineering, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and permitting
- Permit expertise across all local jurisdictions: Town of Kensington (3710 Mitchell St), Town of Garrett Park (4600 Oxford St), City of Rockville (111 Maryland Ave), City of Gaithersburg DPW, MoCo DPS (2425 Reedie Dr Wheaton), DC DOB (1100 4th St SW)
- HPRB guidance for Washington DC historic district properties
- HOA coordination: Kentlands ARC, King Farm HOA, Avenel HOA, Congressional HOA

### Washington, DC
> License required: DC DLCP #410526000209 (Maryland MHIC alone is NOT valid in DC). Permits: DC DOB at 1100 4th Street SW. HPRB guidance for Capitol Hill, Georgetown, Dupont Circle, Logan Circle, and Kalorama historic districts.
